name: SmoothScroll
description: A Lenis-style smooth scroll viewport built from scratch: wheel input drives a target position that a frame-rate independent lerp chases each frame, with an optional progress bar and live velocity readout that make the inertia visible.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" with an aria-label, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrows/Page keys/Space (native, unsmoothed) and see a 2px :focus-visible outline. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move; at the top/bottom edge wheel events are released so the page keeps scrolling. Touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. Under prefers-reduced-motion (or smooth=false) the wheel is not intercepted at all. The progress bar and velocity badge are aria-hidden decorations.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Scrollable content; defaults to a hero plus four editorial sections.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: showProgress
propsApi.description: Show a scroll progress bar along the top edge.

propsApi.name: showVelocity
propsApi.description: Show a live velocity readout badge (px per frame).

propsApi.name: ariaLabel
propsApi.description: Accessible label for the scroll region.

propsApi.name: onScroll
propsApi.type: (state: { scroll: number; limit: number; progress: number; velocity: number }) => void
propsApi.description: Called every scroll frame with scroll position, limit, progress (0..1) and signed velocity.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
